_comment: BMW F10 diagnostics definitions. liveData maps a UDS DID to a physical value (raw*scale+offset over byteLength bytes, big-endian). dtcCatalog gives plain-English text for a fault's high-16-bit code. demoFaults are the codes the offline demo transport pretends each module has stored. As with the coding maps, the DIDs/scales are ILLUSTRATIVE and drive demo mode; real DIDs vary by ECU and I-level. dataIdentifier is decimal (JSON has no hex): 17920 = 0x4600.

liveData.name: Coolant temperature
liveData.description: Engine coolant temperature from the DME.

dtcCatalog.description: Boost pressure control: positive deviation (charge air below target).
Oxygen sensor, bank 1 before catalyst: signal implausible.
Front cornering light: open circuit or short to ground.
Supply voltage: too low during operation.
Instrument cluster: communication timeout with a bus node.
